itemList.description: Supply and Installation of HDPE Floating Wetlands for holding Aquatic plants with appropriate fixtures including specially designed bucket for maximum root development to enable nutrient removal in polluted water body including transportation to site and labour cost for assembly of fames, plants complete.Material specification1)High Density Poly Ethylene Floats of 330mm x 330mm and 60mm in overall depth and wall thickness of 3mm.                                                    2)Opening at the Centre with 160mm dia at the top and 140mm at the bottom along with projections on the sides and provision for locking system.3)6mm dia openings at corners.4)Oval openings on 4 sides for balanced buoyancy and Ribbed at the bottom for providing adequate strength.                                           5)Buckets of 170mm dia at the top and 145mm dia at the bottom with openings on the sides and the bottom and locks at sides.6)Plus, shaped connector pin for interconnecting.7)3-inchHDPE pipes and elbows for supporting the floating frames8)GI wires 22 gauge and PVC binders for fixing/ binding.9)10 mm Nylon ropes for anchoring.10)Minimum of 18 plants per square meter area of the wetlands.11)DLP on materials used for 2 years12)Plants of different species for taking up nutrients from waterbody like CannaIndica, Vetiver, Spider Lilly, Reed, Water Grass, Phragmites and other locally grown varieties in and around the waterbody.
